title: FeatureFlag
description: Authoritative field-level payload schema for the FeatureFlag family of UCOS-DATA-CONTRACT-018 (API-018 Configuration & Metadata, GET /feature-flags/{context}). A FeatureFlag is a context-resolved variability switch of the Configuration domain (DOM-018 / CAP-10; MC-13 variability). Field authority: UCOS-PDATA-ARCH-001. FeatureFlag has no dedicated substrate port type; its fields are established by domain-authority modeling from API-018 operation intent (context resolution), the EVT-018 FeatureFlagChanged event, and the config-variability facet of ConfigurationPort. Transport form deferred to Prompt 08; security controls deferred to Prompt 09.

schema.description: One feature flag resolved for a context.
Feature flag identifier. Source authority: DOM-018 / CAP-10 variability; EVT-018 FeatureFlagChanged names the changed flag (UCOS-CONTRACT-CAT-001 §A).
Resolution context the flag is evaluated for. Source authority: API-018 GET /feature-flags/{context}.

Whether the flag is active in the resolved context. Source authority: the defining semantics of a feature flag (a resolved on/off variability decision) per API-018 'resolve feature flags for context'.
Optional variant payload for multivariate flags. Open object: variant shape is capability-defined. Source authority: MC-13 variability + ConfigurationPort value model (Record<string, unknown>).
